en.title: Cracked tooth: a filling or a crown?

sentences.text: This is a healthy back tooth from the lower jaw.
Ridges join the bumps on top, like the walls of a box.
A cracked tooth has a crack that starts on top and runs down toward the root.
If the crack reaches the nerve inside, you may need root canal treatment.
A large filling goes through both ridges. When you bite, the bumps can still bend apart.
A crown wraps around them and holds them together.
Studies found fewer nerve problems with a crown, but the numbers are not certain.
